## Description
Please include a summary of the change, motivation, and relevant issue(s) closed.

Fixes #(issue)

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing code to not work as expected)
- [ ] Performance optimization (improves compile-time or runtime speed)
- [ ] Documentation update

## Checklist:
- [ ] My code follows the code style and architectural invariants of this project.
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code.
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand compiler IR regions.
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works.
- [ ] All Rust unit and AMA memory safety tests pass (`cargo test`).
- [ ] All 36 specification tests pass (`cargo run --bin aps -- test examples/specification --run`).
